audio_description:
Overhead, Edea's float glides under a glowing blue energy ring.
Ribbons of pale magic coil around her.
Ranks of Galbadian soldiers salute along the route as fireworks light the sky.

context.scene_title: The Deling City parade spectacle — Edea's magical display and the saluting Galbadian troops (Sorceress assassination mission, Disc 1).
locations: Deling City at night — Edea's float/dais and the boulevard lined with ranks of Galbadian soldiers, fireworks above

characters.name: Sorceress Edea
characters.recognition: On the float beneath the glowing blue ring, conjuring swirling ribbons of pale-blue magical energy (shown amid feathers and gold-lit robes).

characters.name: (Galbadian soldiers)
characters.recognition: Rows of uniformed troops standing behind barriers, raising their arms in salute; anonymous Galbadian army ranks.

context.summary: Overhead, Edea's float glides under a glowing blue energy ring as ribbons of pale magic coil around her. The scene cuts to massed ranks of Galbadian soldiers lined along the parade route, raising their arms in salute beneath a sky lit by fireworks, conveying the city's fervor for the new Sorceress.
context.context_note: High confidence on the parade setting; the magic-wielding figure is read as Edea performing her display.
